mentions.name: Update My Address Book
mentions.description: An app that makes it easy to collect mailing addresses from family and friends, originally built for sending out Christmas cards. Recently rewritten with new features including offline support, lists, passkeys, and a new UI; still a work in progress.
mentions.audience: Make it easier to collect mailing addresses from family and friends, e.g. for sending out Christmas cards.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built Update My Address Book (https://updatemyaddressbook.com) more than a decade ago to make it easier to collect addresses from family and friends so that we could send out Christmas cards.
